note: LBL NRA self-service campground (USFS) at the south end on a Lake Barkley embayment near Dover; ~18-19 primitive sites on gravel pads, reached by gravel road; drinking water in the campground; boat ramp. Campers report a steep first entrance and some aprons at an awkward angle for trailers. --Claude
summary: Gatlin Point (LBL self-service): LBL self-service page confirms $10, year-round, pay at the fee tube, vault toilets, pads, boat ramp; no rec.gov listing (first-come kept). No alert. Lakeview kept: the only open ground is the mown clearing by the ramp, no named sites. Stored website now redirects to an image.
flags: WATERFRONT lakeview KEPT. The open part of the campground is a mown clearing at the north-west tip by the boat ramp (around 36.5586,-87.9047): about 110.3 m, ~1 m above the 109.4 m summer pool and ~30-40 m from the embayment over open ground, but no page names sites or pads there (a 2018 camper report calls it 'mowed meadow with no designated sites'), so no upgrade. The road's other spurs south-east sit under continuous canopy, and the main Lake Barkley embayment lies behind a tree belt. Possible lakefront lead if a site map ever shows pads in the clearing. The existing evidence text still fits.
